description: Straight north-south corridor. The room is a simple I — two portals, one at the north end and one at the south, connected by a single uninterrupted corridor along X≈0. A midpoint waypoint (hzj4) sits at the center for objective dispatch.

portals.north: spawn_north at (0.03, -19.30) — gate on the north (low-Z) end
portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.03, 15.66) — gate on the south (high-Z) end

traversalNotes: Straight-line traversal: the autopilot can walk directly between spawn_north and spawn_south — no detour needed.

DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective (key drop, enemy kill, story trigger) should route through corridor_mid (hzj4). Walk from current gate → corridor_mid → objective → corridor_mid → next gate. This keeps the autopilot from cutting diagonals across the corridor that drift into the wall in narrow rooms.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions here are stage-local mesh-space XZ; cell.rotation in the quest plan is a gate-label swap only.
